purpose: Editable starting inputs for synthetic examples and identified disposable demo models.
origin: Owner-authorized illustrative development choices, 2026-09-05; not universal industry values or market quotations.

detailing_preferences.catalogue_note: Search choices, not code minima/maxima. Preserve fixed geometry and check every selected arrangement.

illustrative_rates.note: Synthetic direct-cost inputs only; no market-rate, labor, waste or realized-saving claim.

review_before_real_project_use: Actual member-specific materials and verified strengths
Project design profile, exposure, fire, cover and seismic basis
Geometry, supports, loads and complete required case/combination coverage
Available bars, stock, section catalogue and architectural constraints
Applicable detailing limits, current rates and quantity conventions
behavior: Retained defaults remain labelled demo. Checks may reject any starting value; prefilled inputs do not imply a passing design.
